title: CivAgent regime topology
description: Explicit governance graph for one regime (regimes/<region>/<id>/topology.json). Nodes are roles from the regime's IDENTITY.md role mapping table; edges are typed instruction/information flows between them. This makes the 57 regimes a computable design space.

regime.description: region/regime-id, e.g. china/tang. Must match the directory the file lives in.

mode.description: Orchestration mode; must correspond to metadata.json's orchestrationPattern (after alias normalization).

nodes.description: Role nodes. The set of ids must equal the Agent ID set in the regime's IDENTITY.md role mapping table.

id.description: Agent ID exactly as in IDENTITY.md (e.g. zhongshu-sheren).

label.description: Human-readable historical role name (e.g. 中书舍人).

functional_role.description: Canonical functional role (same 9-value vocabulary as engine/regime-to-cc.mjs ROLE_MODEL_MAP).

edges.description: Typed directed flows between role nodes.

kind.description: command = instruction flow / reporting; review = checks / auditing; info = information sharing; veto = rejection / 封驳.

note.description: Optional provenance note (e.g. which IDENTITY.md flow step justifies this edge).

edges.note: 御史大夫全程监察百官
